subject: SIG: request for version delta, re-answers, and evidence
messages:
From: Devon Price <devon.price@acme-fin.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-fin.com
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG version delta + evidence request (time-sensitive)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking the call last week. Our security team reviewed the latest SIG that Redwood submitted and flagged a small number of re-answers compared to the version we reviewed in June. They asked for (1) a short delta/summary of what changed between the versions, (2) the re-answered questions marked in the canonical SIG spreadsheet, and (3) supporting evidence for any control assertions that moved from "partial" to "yes."

We'd appreciate that by EOD Friday if possible — Acme is preparing a vendor review ahead of a board audit. If you can't meet that window, an interim note detailing the scope of changes would help.

Can you confirm the owner(s) of the re-answers and where we can pull the evidence artifacts?

Thanks,
Devon
Devon Price
Senior Manager, Vendor Risk
Acme Financial Services

Attachments: none

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Devon Price <devon.price@acme-fin.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG version delta + evidence request (time-sensitive)

Hi Devon —

Thanks for the heads up. We saw the same redlines in our tracking. We're preparing a short delta document and will mark re-answered items in the canonical SIG. Preliminary answers: most changes are clarifications (answers expanded, references added), two items were tightened after our recent SOC 2 evidence collection which moved them from "partial" to "yes."

I can get you the delta and a folder of artifacts by Thursday EOD PST. Will that work for your audit timeline?

I'll loop in Karthik (security lead) and Neha (compliance ops) to pull the detailed artifacts.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG version delta + evidence request (time-sensitive)

Folks — forwarding Acme's ask. Short tasks below:

- Karthik: can you confirm which controls were re-answered and attach the primary evidence (runbooks, control screenshots, SOC 2 artifact ids)?
- Neha: please generate a CSV mapping of question IDs -> old answer -> new answer and flag any upward changes to "yes." Include a quick note on evidence location (Drive path + filename).

I want a draft delta doc and the evidence folder link by Thursday 9/10 EOD PST. If anything looks like it will slip, call it out now.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG version delta + evidence request (time-sensitive)

Marissa/Neha — quick update from the control owners: two question IDs (SIG-6.2.1 and SIG-9.4.3) had clarifying re-answers. Evidence files attached below:

- runbook-access-logs-2026-08.zip (contains exported access logs and reviewer notes)
- config-snapshots-202608.tar.gz (configuration snapshots for the access control rule) — NOTE: redacted; will provide hashed manifests only for shared artifacts
I've uploaded an evidence table to Drive and added a short note for each re-answer (path: /SIG-evidence/Acme/202609). Neha, you should be able to pull the CSV from that folder.
Karthik
Principal Security Engineer
Attachments: runbook-access-logs-2026-08.zip, evidence-table-20260908.csv

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Devon Price <devon.price@acme-fin.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: SIG delta, re-answers CSV and evidence bundle (Acme)

Devon —

Thanks for your patience. Attached are: (1) a short delta memo describing the scope of changes between the submitted SIG (v202606) and our updated responses (v202609), (2) a CSV mapping question IDs to old/new answers (attached: evidence-table-20260908.csv), and (3) an evidence bundle zipped with reviewer notes (runbook-access-logs-2026-08.zip).

Summary (high level):
- Total re-answered items: 7 (mostly clarifications; 2 items moved from partial -> yes).
- Controls moved to yes: SIG-6.2.1 (access review cadence documented) and SIG-9.4.3 (encryption key rotation verification).
- Where applicable we've provided screenshots, SOC 2 artifact references, and hashed manifests for any sensitive config artifacts.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq_bX_SIG-evidence
HubSpot: HS-48291
If you'd like a short walkthrough call, happy to schedule.
Best,
Neha Kapoor
Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SIG_v1.4_reanswers.diff.pdf, evidence-table-20260908.csv, runbook-access-logs-2026-08.zip
